cases.test_scenario: Verify that submitting a Name and an unregistered Email Address in the New User Signup! block opens the Enter Account Information page
preconditions: User is not logged in (guest) and is on http://automationexercise.com/login
An email address that has never been registered on the site is available for use

steps.expected_result: Page shows a 'Login to your account' section and a separate 'New User Signup!' section; the signup section contains a Name field, an Email Address field and a 'Signup' button

steps.action: In the 'New User Signup!' section enter Name = 'OC QA' and Email Address = an unregistered email (e.g. oc.qa.<timestamp>@example.com), then click 'Signup'
steps.expected_result: The 'Enter Account Information' page is displayed, containing the 'Enter Account Information' block and the 'Address Information' block with a 'Create Account' button

steps.action: Check the Name and Email Address shown on the 'Enter Account Information' page
steps.expected_result: Name shows 'OC QA' and Email Address shows the email entered in the previous step (values carried over from signup step 1)

cases.notes: Source: TCr1-S4~S7 (Register User). Covers FR-ACC-01 AC1.

cases.test_scenario: Verify that completing the account and address information and clicking Create Account creates the account, shows the Account Created! page, and that Continue returns the user to a logged-in session
preconditions: The 'Enter Account Information' page is open for an unregistered email (reached via New User Signup! with a valid Name and Email)
A password meeting the site's rules is available (e.g. Password123!)

steps.action: Select Title 'Mr.' (or 'Mrs.'), fill Password, Date of Birth (Day/Month/Year), and the address fields First name, Last name, Company, Address, Address 2, Country, State, City, Zipcode and Mobile Number
steps.expected_result: All entered values are accepted and remain displayed in their respective fields
The 'Account Created!' page is displayed showing the text 'Congratulations! Your new account has been successfully created!' and a 'Continue' link
The user is returned to the site in a logged-in state and the header displays 'Logged in as <name>' using the name given at signup

steps.action: Inspect the header as a logged-in user
steps.expected_result: Header shows 'Logged in as <name>' together with 'Logout' and 'Delete Account' links instead of 'Signup / Login'

cases.notes: Source: TCr1-S9~S16 (Register User). Covers FR-ACC-02 AC1 and AC2. Field-level format validation is not specified by the PRD (see open questions).

cases.test_scenario: Verify that signing up with an already registered email address is rejected with the error 'Email Address already exist!' and does not open the account information page
preconditions: An account already exists with email E (e.g. created by the registration flow)
User is on /login as a guest

steps.action: In the 'New User Signup!' section enter Name = 'OC QA' and Email Address = E (the already registered email), then click 'Signup'
steps.expected_result: The error message 'Email Address already exist!' is displayed

steps.action: Observe the page and URL after the error
steps.expected_result: The user remains on /login with the 'Login to your account' and 'New User Signup!' sections still visible; the 'Enter Account Information' page is not displayed

cases.notes: Source: TCr5-S4~S8 (Register existing email). Covers FR-ACC-03 AC. Email case sensitivity / trimming on this uniqueness check is undefined (see open questions).

cases.test_scenario: Verify that logging in with a correct email and password authenticates the user and shows 'Logged in as <name>' in the header
preconditions: A registered account exists with a known valid email and password
User is on /login as a guest

steps.action: In the 'Login to your account' section enter the valid Email Address and Password, then click 'Login'
steps.expected_result: The user is logged in and the header displays 'Logged in as <name>' matching the account's name

steps.action: Check the login/signup state of the page after logging in
steps.expected_result: The header no longer shows the 'Signup / Login' link and instead shows 'Logged in as <name>', 'Logout' and 'Delete Account'

cases.notes: Source: TCr2-S4~S8, TCr4-S4~S8 (Login correct). Covers FR-ACC-04 AC1.

cases.test_scenario: Verify that logging in with incorrect credentials shows 'Your email or password is incorrect!' and keeps the user on /login as a guest
preconditions: A registered account exists with a known valid email and password
User is on /login as a guest

steps.action: In the 'Login to your account' section enter a registered Email Address with a wrong Password (also check the representative case of an unregistered email address), then click 'Login'
steps.expected_result: The error message 'Your email or password is incorrect!' is displayed

steps.action: Observe the page, URL and header after the failed login
steps.expected_result: The user stays on /login with 'Login to your account' and 'New User Signup!' visible; the header still shows 'Signup / Login' and no 'Logged in as <name>' text appears

cases.notes: Source: TCr3-S4~S8 (Login incorrect). Covers FR-ACC-04 AC2. Behaviour for empty email/password is not specified by the PRD (see open questions).

cases.test_scenario: Verify that clicking Logout ends the session and returns the user to /login in guest state
preconditions: A user is logged in (header shows 'Logged in as <name>')

steps.action: Click the 'Logout' link in the site header
steps.expected_result: The user is returned to /login, where the 'Login to your account' and 'New User Signup!' sections are visible
Header shows the 'Signup / Login' link again; 'Logged in as <name>', 'Logout' and 'Delete Account' are no longer displayed

cases.test_scenario: Verify that Delete Account permanently deletes the account, shows the Account Deleted! page, and that Continue returns the user to guest state
preconditions: A user is logged in with an account that may be deleted (e.g. the account created during registration)

steps.action: Click the 'Delete Account' link in the site header
steps.expected_result: The 'Account Deleted!' page is displayed showing the text 'Your account has been permanently deleted!' and a 'Continue' link
The user is no longer logged in and the header shows the 'Signup / Login' link instead of 'Logged in as <name>'

cases.notes: Source: TCr1-S17~S18, TCr2-S9~S10 (Register User / Login correct cleanup step). Covers FR-ACC-06 AC. This feature doubles as the test-data cleanup mechanism.

open_questions: 密碼規則未定義：註冊時 Password 的最小長度／複雜度要求為何？不符合時是否阻止建立帳號、顯示什麼訊息？
註冊 Step 2 各欄位的必填與格式規則未定義：Name、Password、Date of Birth、Address、Country、State、City、Zipcode、Mobile Number 哪些為必填？空值或格式錯誤（如 Zipcode 非數字、Mobile Number 格式、Email 格式）時的錯誤訊息與是否阻止建立？
Email 的比對規則未定義：註冊唯一性檢查與登入比對是否忽略大小寫（Foo@x.com vs foo@x.com）與前後空白？若僅大小寫不同，Signup 是否仍顯示 `Email Address already exist!`？
註冊的兩步驟之間若中途離開：Step 1 通過後未按 Create Account 即離開或直接以網址造訪帳號資訊頁，是否會留下半成品帳號或 session？
同一個未註冊 Email 在 Step 1 通過後、按下 Create Account 前被他人註冊時，Create Account 的結果與訊息為何？
登入時 Email 或 Password 留空即送出：是否顯示 `Your email or password is incorrect!`、單一欄位的必填訊息，或客户端直接阻擋？
已登入會員直接存取 /login、/ 或註冊區塊時，是否被導向其他頁面或隱藏登入/註冊表單（權限轉導規則）？
Session 持續性未定義：登入後重新整理頁面或關閉再開瀏覽器，登入狀態是否維持？是否有逾時登出？
Delete Account 是否需要二次確認（確認對話框）？PRD 未描述，誤點是否會直接永久刪除？
刪除帳號後的行為未定義：被刪除的 Email 是否可立即用於重新註冊？以原帳密登入應顯示 `Your email or password is incorrect!` 還是其他訊息？
`Sign up for our newsletter!` 與 `Receive special offers from our partners!` 兩個 opt-in checkbox 是否必勾？勾選／未勾選對建立帳號或後續行為有無影響？
